description: Versioned router fails to match date-based and case-variant API version headers, routing v2 clients to legacy v1 formats.
spec_notes: VersionedAPIRouter must route '2026-01' and case-insensitive 'V2' headers to V2Adapter.

tests.test_version_routing.py:
from router import VersionedAPIRouter


def test_default_v1_routing():
    r = VersionedAPIRouter()
    res = r.route_request({}, "u1", "Alice")
    assert res["version"] == "v1"
    assert res["name"] == "Alice"


def test_header_version_v2_routing():
    r = VersionedAPIRouter()
    res = r.route_request({"X-API-Version": "v2"}, "u2", "Bob")
    assert res["version"] == "v2"
    assert res["data"]["displayName"] == "Bob"


def test_date_based_version_routing():
    r = VersionedAPIRouter()
    res = r.route_request({"X-API-Version": "2026-01"}, "u3", "Charlie")
    assert res["version"] == "v2"
    assert res["data"]["userId"] == "u3"


def test_accept_header_content_negotiation():
    r = VersionedAPIRouter()
    res = r.route_request({"Accept": "application/vnd.app.v2+json"}, "u4", "Dave")
    assert res["version"] == "v2"
